AntiPattern.Bad: Agent runs `playwright codegen`, copies `page.locator('#root > div:nth-child(3) > button.submit')` straight into the committed test.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Codegen output committed without review (`AX_CLI_CODEGEN_IS_RECORDER_NOT_AUTHOR`). The structural path breaks on the first DOM reordering, and the CSS class is implementation-coupled. Codegen is a recorder, not an author.
AntiPattern.Good: Read the AX snapshot of the same region, replace the generated locator with the role-based equivalent (`getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' })`) before any line of codegen output lands in the test.
